name: Grilled Steak Wrap with Red Onion, Mixed Greens, Tomato & Blue Cheese

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic. Place in a large bowl along with vinegar, oil, maple syrup, Dijon, and spices. Whisk to combine the marinade.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
3 tbsp balsamic vinegar
1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp pure maple syrup
1 ½ tsp Dijon mustard
¾ tsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pat the steak dry with paper towels, then slice against the grain into ¼-inch thick strips. Add to the bowl with the marinade, turn to coat, and set aside.
Meanwhile, preheat a grill pan or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Peel and thinly slice onions into rings.
Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil. Working in batches if necessary, transfer onions to the grill pan and cook until tender, 3-4 minutes per side.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the mixed greens. (Skip if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (142 g) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry tomatoes. Using a clean cutting board, halve tomatoes and thinly slice into half-moons. Transfer to a platter and season with salt and pepper; set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tomatoes
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the onions are done cooking, transfer to the platter with the tomatoes.
Working in batches if necessary, place steak strips on the grill pan, and cook to desired doneness, about 1 minute per side for medium-rare. Transfer to the platter with the veggies.
Place tortillas on a flat surface. Divide steak, onions, mixed greens, tomatoes, and blue cheese between them. Roll tightly to close and cut in half.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 large flour tortillas
1 ½ (113 g) pkg crumbled blue cheese

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide wraps between plates and enjoy!
